cases.context: t_form is owned. The previously read fixture identifies #name, #country and #subscribe uniquely. Fill only; never submit. Actual website autosave is outside the meaning of draft mode.
python:
await browser.input(tab_id='t_form', target={'selector': '#name'}, text='Ada')
await browser.select(tab_id='t_form', target={'selector': '#country'}, values=['US'])
await browser.check(tab_id='t_form', target={'selector': '#subscribe'}, checked=True)
observed = await browser.query(tab_id='t_form', selector='#name, #country, #subscribe', fields=['name', 'value', 'checked'])
emit({'observed': observed['data'], 'truncated': observed['truncated']})

cases.context: Open the two task-supplied public URLs in background tabs, sequentially. Operator/user cleanup is separate because read mode cannot close tabs. Returned handles, not indices, bind each read.
python:
pages = []
for url in ['https://example.test/alpha', 'https://example.test/beta']:
    opened = await browser.new_tab(url=url)
    tab_id = opened['data']['tab_id']
    page = await browser.read(tab_id=tab_id, format='text')
    pages.append({'tab_id': tab_id, 'text': page['data']['text'], 'truncated': page['truncated']})
emit(pages)

The task identifies the account tab by its exact URL. First program returns a held continuation. Only after an external user approval does the caller start the second fresh program, using the exact returned call/token. The synthetic approval event below is not code granting authority, nor evidence #496 is implemented.

external_events.event: user approved the scoped tab request

error.hint: Wait for external approval; do not self-approve

python:
listed = await browser.tabs()
matches = [tab for tab in listed['data']['tabs'] if tab['url'] == 'https://example.test/account']
if len(matches) != 1:
    raise ValueError('Choose one unambiguous user tab')
try:
    await browser.request_tab(tab_id=matches[0]['tab_id'])
except BrowserOperationError as error:
    if error.result['error']['code'] != 'needs_user':
        raise
    emit({'call': error.result['call'], 'resume_token': error.result['data']['resume_token']})
# Fresh invocation only AFTER external approval; substitute the actual returned values.
await browser.resume(call='c_held', resume_token='r_fixture')
page = await browser.read(tab_id='t_user')
emit(page['data'])
